articles.title: Guru Nanak Jayanti 2026: When Is Gurpurab? Check Date, History, Significance and Celebrations
articles.description: Guru Nanak Jayanti 2026 will be celebrated on Tuesday, November 24, marking the 557th birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the founder of Sikhism. Also known as Gurpurab, the sacred occasion falls on Kartik Purnima and commemorates his teachings of equality, devotion, honest living and selfless service. Explore the history and religious significance of Gurpurab, the three central principles of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, and how devotees celebrate the festival through Akhand Path, Nagar Kirtan, prayers and Langar.
